title: After the Hanshin J.F.: Child Prodigy

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I manage to win the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies! Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It was difficult, but thanks to Trainer's guidance and care during practice, races aren't as hard on my body anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: People even praise Trainer! ♪ Maybe it was actually important that we met now, instead of later…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If that's the case… I want to bring home another big race victory for Trainer. Next up, I'm taking on the Oka Sho on the Tiara tour!
